summary: Idle is one screen. Git lists remotes and a default base; home history follows the listed branch. A second click is a range. Review walks that pick, or the branch against the default base. Working changes attach only to a dirty checkout. Tests and command-id lists are skipped.

test/helpers/model.ts.rationale: Harness waits for remotes and history

test/unit/home-setup.test.ts.rationale: Machine cases for the rules you walk

test/unit/home-sidebar.test.ts.rationale: Row contract for the home screen

steps.title: Argv remotes and a default base
steps.rationale: The git contract every later selector and branch walk uses
steps.notes: Hostile names never reach argv. Default base prefers upstream, then origin HEAD/main/master, then local main/master. Fetch is `git fetch -- <remote>`.

steps.title: History of a chosen ref
steps.rationale: The list the branch selector will point at this layer

steps.title: Home holds refs and a selection
steps.rationale: The idle phase the sidebar will render instead of three wizard rows

steps.title: History follows the listed branch
steps.rationale: First consumer of log-rev — and the rule that keeps WIP off a remote ref
steps.notes: Working changes are selected only when the listed branch is the dirty checkout. Viewing another ref while main is dirty leaves selection empty so Review does not walk local WIP.

steps.title: Clicks become the review target
steps.rationale: The machine the header button will start — still on home, no generate wizard
steps.notes: A second commit click is a range, older from and newer to, same as the leftover range picker. With nothing picked, a non-default branch walks as default-base to that branch. Working changes stay on home.

steps.title: One screen: selectors, list, Review
steps.rationale: Projects the home phase into rows: native selects, commit clicks, one primary

steps.title: Review sits in the header
steps.rationale: Same chrome slot as Use range and Next — the one filled action
